databaseQueries.query: SELECT `roles`.*, `model_has_roles`.`model_id` as `pivot_model_id`, `model_has_roles`.`role_id` as `pivot_role_id`, `model_has_roles`.`model_type` as `pivot_model_type` FROM `roles` inner join `model_has_roles` on `roles`.`id` = `model_has_roles`.`role_id` WHERE `model_has_roles`.`model_id` = 18 and `model_has_roles`.`model_type` = 'App\\Models\\User'
SELECT exists(SELECT * FROM `branches` inner join `user_branch` on `branches`.`id` = `user_branch`.`branch_id` WHERE `user_branch`.`user_id` = 18 and `branches`.`id` = 2) as `exists`
SELECT sum(`paid_amount`) as aggregate FROM `sales` WHERE `branch_id` = 2
SELECT sum(`due_amount`) as aggregate FROM `sales` WHERE `branch_id` = 2
SELECT count(*) as aggregate FROM `sales` WHERE `branch_id` = 2 and `status` = 'completed'
SELECT count(*) as aggregate FROM `sales` WHERE `branch_id` = 2 and `status` = 'pending'
SELECT sum(`grand_total`) as aggregate FROM `sales` WHERE `branch_id` = 2 and date(`created_at`) = '2026-10-15'
SELECT sum(`grand_total`) as aggregate FROM `sales` WHERE `branch_id` = 2 and `created_at` between '2026-10-12 00:00:00' and '2026-10-18 23:59:59'
SELECT sum(`grand_total`) as aggregate FROM `sales` WHERE `branch_id` = 2 and year(`created_at`) = 2026 and month(`created_at`) = '10'
SELECT sum(`grand_total`) as aggregate FROM `sales` WHERE `branch_id` = 2

SELECT `products`.`name` as `product_name`, `products`.`image` as `product_image`, `products`.`code` as `product_code`, SUM(sale_details.quantity) as total_sold FROM `sale_details` inner join `products` on `sale_details`.`product_id` = `products`.`id` inner join `sales` on `sale_details`.`sale_id` = `sales`.`id` WHERE `sales`.`branch_id` = 2 GROUP BY `products`.`id`, `products`.`name`, `products`.`image`, `products`.`code` ORDER BY `total_sold` DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT SUM(grand_total) as total_amount, MONTH(created_at) as month FROM `sales` WHERE `branch_id` = 2 and year(`created_at`) = '2026' GROUP BY `month` ORDER BY `month` ASC
SELECT * FROM `sales` WHERE `branch_id` = 2 ORDER BY `created_at` DESC LIMIT 5
